rejected_candidates.candidate: User-uploaded Creator Store sound effects (coin, level-up, cash-register searches)
rejected_candidates.reason: Uploaded by individual users with no stated licence; several name another game ('From CSGO', 'cod zombies') or a third-party source needing credit ('credits to LilMati on freesound'), or say 'for personal use'. Rights unclear for a monetised experience.

Not rejected on licence grounds (DistroKid tracks are distributed to Roblox for use in experiences), but APMOfficial tracks were preferred: Roblox's long-standing licensed library with full metadata. Kept as alternatives.
